rules: Political authority is distinct from military and intelligence membership.
Leadership and policy are temporal World State.
Ship command does not imply Tal Shiar membership.
Tal Shiar is a distinct intelligence/security organization.
Species, citizenship, uniform or secrecy do not prove membership.

ai_guardrails: Do not infer Tal Shiar affiliation from Romulan species.
Do not expose covert membership unless observer knowledge permits it.
Do not merge military and intelligence chains of command.
